Ava (Sales): Heads-up: Harbor (customer) just emailed final commit ask. They want reserved capacity + autoscale for spikes, and the security questionnaire answered this week. Can we do a quick sizing + list out what they need for the questionnaire?
Jordan (Harbor Tech): Thanks Ava. Peak profile: 200 RPS sustained during business hours, burst to ~800 RPS for 5-10m windows (event-driven). Average tokens per request ~150 (30 in / 120 out). 95th tail latency target <500ms for single-turn chat. Need HIPAA-ish level controls; will share questionnaire.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Got it. Quick back-of-envelope: 200 * 150 = 30k tokens/sec sustained. For the model they want (open-llm-1-lg, quantized recommended) we measure ~20k tokens/s per A10G-equivalent when using batching+kv cache warm. So sustained -> ~2 GPUs, but we want headroom and preheat time for KV cache. Burst to 800 -> needs ability to ramp to ~8 GPUs (or shard across variants). Proposals:
- Option A: Reserved pool 3 GPUs (handles sustained + headroom) + autoscale up to 8 for bursts (burst credits/spot or reserved burst slots).
- Option B: Reserved 2 GPUs + strict burst policy + fallback to smaller quantized model with degraded RPS.
Which price/latency tradeoff they prefer?
Ava (Sales): They prefer predictability but are sensitive to commit cost. Also asked for a concrete preheat plan for KV cache and a sample autoscale policy we can show legal/ops.
Rohan (Infra PM): Preheat/KV warm notes: plan to run synthetic warm requests 10-15 minutes before business hours and before known events. KV cache warmup ideally targeted per-prefix; global warm adds more cost. We should add a cooldown after spikes to avoid thrashing. Suggested autoscale settings snippet:
```json
{
  "min_replicas": 3,
  "max_replicas": 8,
  "scale_up_threshold_rps": 250,
  "scale_down_threshold_rps": 180,
  "scale_up_cooldown_s": 60,
  "scale_down_cooldown_s": 300
}
```
Sam (Solutions Eng): Also recommend model routing: route to full model for high-quality tasks, route less-latency-sensitive calls to quantized variant during sustained bursts. KV cache TTL 24h for session prefixes. For cost estimate (very rough): reserved 3x A10G-equivalent + occasional burst to 8 = ~3x baseline cost + transient. I will run exact pricing with finance.
Priya (Security): Questionnaire checklist: network diagram, data flow, encryption at rest (KMS), encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+), access controls (RBAC + SSO), retention policy, audit logs, SOC2 + HIPAA controls mapping. I can fill most controls but need customer to confirm PHI in payloads and provide legal contact. Also note: private deployment (VPC) looks preferred for their compliance ask; that changes onboarding timeline by ~2-3 weeks.
Jordan (Harbor Tech): We do send PHI in some flows. Private VPC makes sense. Timeline: they want go/no-go decision by EOW. Can we commit answers + sizing doc by Thursday?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Yes. Action plan: I will produce a one-pager with sizing calculations, autoscale JSON, preheat checklist, and cost ranges. Rohan will add operational runbook for preheat + cooldown. Priya will fill questionnaire draft and list outstanding customer inputs. Target to share draft by Wednesday, final by Thursday.
Ava (Sales): Perfect. Jordan, I'll coordinate to get the questionnaire + legal contact. @Jordan please drop the questionnaire link here when ready. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled smoke test: harbor-sustained-200rps on 2026-03-25T14:00Z -> assigned to @Sam, @Rohan.
Jordan (Harbor Tech): Dropping questionnaire link: https://harbor-sec.example.com/questionnaire/harbor-redwood-2026. I'll get the legal contact in the next message.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll also add a fallback suggestion to use an 8-bit quantized variant (quality delta small for many prompts) to save during bursts. Will include perf numbers and sample request patterns to reproduce.
Rohan (Infra PM): I'll prepare slot reservation notes: AZ spread, preheat window, and failover policy (if spot eviction occurs shift traffic to quantized model).
Priya (Security): One quick ask: for KMS we need to know their key provider (AWS KMS vs customer-managed HSM). Jordan, can you confirm?
Jordan (Harbor Tech): Using AWS KMS with CMKs. Legal contact: claire.t@harbor.com. I'll also share a sample PHI payload with redacted PII for test warm.
Ava (Sales): Great. Summarizing action items: Sam -> sizing doc + autoscale snippet; Rohan -> preheat runbook + slot reservation; Priya -> questionnaire draft; Ava -> coordinate questionnaire/legal; Jordan -> share PHI sample + confirm KMS (done). Target: draft by Wed, final by Thu.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Copy that. I'll try to include an estimated daily cost band for reserved 3x vs reserved 2x + burst mode.
Ava (Sales): Thanks everyone. Quick reminder: keep the doc customer-friendly (one-pager + appendix with ops details). :white_check_mark:
